*****NOTE FROM THE CITY: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION: Due to the existing COVID-19 health
emergency and the social distancing measures currently in effect, and pursuant to the

Please note that members of the public will be allowed to observe and/or address the City
Council Meeting of April 13, 2021, at 1:00 P.M. for closed session as follows:

  1.  Written Public Comments: Members of the public may choose to submit comments
  electronically for consideration by the Inglewood City Council/Successor
  Agency/Housing Authority/Finance Authority/Parking Authority/Joint Powers
  Authority (Legislative Body) by sending them to the City Clerk/Secretary at
  athompson@cityofinglewood.org and Deputy City Clerk at
  aallen@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure distribution to the members of the Legislative
  Body prior to consideration of the agenda, please submit comments prior to 8:00
  A.M. the day of the meeting, and in the body of the email, please identify the agenda
  number or subject matter. Correspondence should indicate the meeting date and
  agenda item. Comments received after 8:00 A.M. and prior to the close of the public
  hearings, will be made part of the official public record of the meeting. Contact the
  Office of the City Clerk at 310-412-5280 with any questions.

  2.  By Telephone-Listening to the Meeting and Making Oral Public Comments:
  Members of the public can participate in the meeting by telephone to listen and make
  comments by using the following:

  l Dial-In: 1-669-900-6833 (Meeting ID: 996 1738 7790; Passcode: 5111).
  l All interested parties who wished to provide public comments telephonically may join
  the conference at 12:50 p.m.
  l If you are dialing in from a cell phone, please call from an area with good reception.
  Calls from landline phones are highly recommended.

** The above access options provide the public with the opportunity to address the
Legislative Body on Closed Session Items.

  2.  By Telephone-Listening to the Meeting and Making Oral Public Comments:

  l The conference begins at 1:30 p.m., Pacific Time, and all interested parties may join

  comments on the phone line, you will be inaudible due to feedback.
  l Dial-In: 1-888-251-2949 or 1-215-861-0694 using the specific access codes detailed
  below for the respective City Council Dates:
  ¡ May 4, 2021 – Access Code: 2012120# wait two seconds and press # again
  ¡ May 11, 2021 – Access Code: 2175831# wait two seconds and press # again
  ¡ May 18, 2021 – Access Code: 1813035# wait two seconds and press # again
  ¡ May 25, 2021 – Access Code: 2489941# wait two seconds and press # again

  3.  Viewing and Listening to the Meeting without Making Public Comments:

  l  On Spectrum Cable Channel 35 with audio and limited video. Please check with your

The above access options provide the public with the opportunity to both observe and
listen to the meeting; however, members of the public who wish to orally address the
Legislative Body must use the public access options 1 and 2 noted above.
ACCESSIBILITY: If requested, the agenda and backup materials will be made available in
appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability, as required by Section 202 of
the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (42 U.S.C. Sec. 12132), and the federal rules and
regulations adopted in implementation thereof. Any person who requires a disability-
related modification or accommodation, or translation services in order to observe and/or
offer public comment may request such reasonable modification, accommodation, or

412-5533, One Manchester Boulevard, First Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301
or via email to athompson@cityofinglewood.org and aallen@cityofinglewood.org no later
than 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting.

minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  May 11, 2021

The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on Tuesday,
May 11, 2021, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

Mayor Butts called the City Council into Closed Session at the hour of 1:01 p.m.
The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:
  Present:  Mayor Butts, Council Members Dotson, and Faulk; and
  Absent:  Council Member Padilla, and Council Member Morales
  arrived at 1:03 p.m.
City officials and personnel present for closed session were as follows:

  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk
  Artie Fields  City Manager
  Ken Campos  City Attorney
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING CLOSED SESSION ITEMS. Mayor Butts
inquired if there were any persons present who wished to address the City Council on the
Closed Session Item.

There was no response.

Mayor Butts recessed the City Council at the hour of 1:04 p.m. for Closed Session Item
No. CS-1.

  *****************

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority at the
hour of 2:00 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary announced the
presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman Butts, Council Members/Successor Agency
  Members/Housing Authority Members Dotson, Padilla,
  Morales and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.
City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority officials and personnel present were as
follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

* Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority.
PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present
who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority on any
item on the Agenda.
Marvin McCoy commented on the Warrants and Bills, and also requested a video from
the Inglewood Police Department.
   May 11, 2021

  Caller (Name Unknown) commented on Warrants and Bills, and Agenda Item Nos. 2,
  approval of the Minutes of the Meetings held on October 6, 2020, and October 13, 2020,
  SPH-1, the setting of a public hearing for an application from Inglewood Tow Service,
  Inc., and O-1, ordinance to amend Inglewood Municipal Code Chapter 8, Articles 9 and
  10, and Chapter 2, Article 3.

  Council Member Morales left the dais at 2:06 p.m.

142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council Member/
  Successor Agency Member / Housing Authority Member Padilla, and seconded by
  Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member Faulk that the
  demands presented to the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority dated May
  7, 2021, in the amount of $5,115,723.61 are hereby allowed, and the City
  Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to
  certify upon said registers that said demands are so approved. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Faulk, and Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing
  Authority Chairman Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member/ Successor Agency Member/ Housing Authority Member
  Morales.

  Council Member Morales returned to the dais at 2:10 p.m.

  MINUTES. It was moved by Council Member Dotson, and seconded by Council
  Member Padilla that the Minutes for the City Council Meetings held on October 6, 2020,
  and October 13, 2020, be approved. The motion was carried by the following roll call
  vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Abstain: Council Member Faulk.

178  PUBLIC HEARING SET – APPLICATION FROM INGLEWOOD TOW
  SERVICE, INC., TO OBTAIN A PERMIT TO PROVIDE CITY REFERRAL
  TOWING SERVICES. Staff report dated May 11, 2021, was presented requesting that
  a public hearing be set to receive public comments on the application from Inglewood
  Tow Service, Inc., to obtain a permit to provide City referral towing services.

  Mayor Butts set the public hearing for May 25, 2021, at the hour of 2:00 p.m.

131.8  ORDINANCE NO. 21-09 ADOPTED – INGLEWOOD MUNICIPLE CODE
  CHAPTER 8, ARTICLES 9 AND 10, AND CHAPTER 2, ARTICE 3. Staff report
  dated May 11, 2021, was presented recommending the adoption of Ordinance No. 21-09
  to amend Inglewood Municipal Code Chapter 8 (Businesses, Trades, and Professions),
  Articles 9 (Just Cause Eviction Protections) and 10 (Residential Rent Regulations), and
  Chapter 2 (Administration), Article 3 (Boards and Commissions).

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  further reading be waived. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  Thereupon, it was moved by Mayor Butts, and seconded by Council Member Dotson that
  Ordinance No. 21-09 entitled:

  AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA
  AMENDING CHAPTER 2, SECTION 2-152.88 (RENTAL HOUSING
  BOARD) OF THE INGLEWOOD MUNICIPAL CODE, AND CHAPTER 8,
  ARTICLE 9 (JUST CAUSE EVICTION PROTECTIONS) AND ARTICLE 10
  (RESIDENTIAL RENT REGULATIONS) TO PROVIDE ADDITIONAL
  PROTECTIONS FOR TENANTS AND OWNERS REGARDING
 May 11, 2021

  RESIDENTIAL RENTAL PROPERTIES WITHIN THE CITY.

  which was introduced as amended at the meeting held on May 4, 2021, be adopted. The
  motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  CLOSED SESSION – EXISTING LITIGATION WITH CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  V. QUON, ET. AL (APN: 4032-001-048); CITY OF INGLEWOOD V. JAMES
  MASATAKAMICHINO, ET. AL. (APN: 4032-001-048; AND CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD V. BHALLA DEV ANAND BHALLA AND ROOP BHALLA, ET.
  AL. Closed session - Confidential – Attorney/Client Privileged; Conference with Legal
  Counsel – Existing Litigation Pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9(a)(d)(1).
  Three (3) Cases: 1) City of Inglewood v. Quon, et. Al. (APN: 4032-001-048); Los
  Angeles Superior Court Case No. 21STCV06251; 2) City of Inglewood v. James
  Masataka Michino, et. al. (APN: 4032-001-048); Los Angeles Superior Court Case No.
  21STCV06064; 3) City of Inglewood v. Bhalla Dev Anand Bhalla and Roopa Bhalla, et.
  Al. (APN: 4332-007-035); Los Angeles Superior Court Case No. 21STCV06065.

  Discussion held; No action taken.

  REPORTS – CITY CLERK. The City Clerk, Aisha L. Thompson, wished Council
  Member Padilla a happy birthday.

  PUBLIC REMARKS. Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present who
  wished to address the City Council on any matter connected with City business not
  elsewhere considered on the Agenda.

  Caller (Name Unknown) spoke regarding Brown Act Violations, Police Oversight
  Committee, and Inglewood Police Department not responding to her complaint.

  Gil Mathieu, District 4, commented on Agenda Item No. SPH-1, the setting of a public
  hearing for an application from Inglewood Tow Service, Inc. He also spoke regarding
  problems with the phone system and requested the Council meeting to be held at 6:00
  p.m.

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned in memory of Rohelia Beal, Lawrence Massingale, James Creer, and Eric Bell,
  retired Police Officer at the hour of 2:20 p.m.

  Approved this 21st day of September, 2021.

  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk

  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Mayor
